changes.historical_text: You can only activate this card when you take damage to your Life Points. Inflict 700 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. Also, inflict 300 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each "Attack and Receive" card in your Graveyard.
changes.summary: Era activation semantics with no text change: the goat script adds `tp~=rp` to the activation check, so it may only be activated when the damage you took was inflicted by your opponent (upstream annotation: "You can only use it when the oppo inflicts damage"); the modern script asks only `ep==tp`, so damage you inflict on yourself with your own card also switches it on. The printed line 'when you take damage to your Life Points' is identical in the goat entry and the pinned modern text, so the difference is purely the era reading of who inflicts the damage. Chronology of that reading change is unresolved.

review.notes: The baseline implements lineage v1 (DB1-EN173, 2004-10-12), which is exactly the pinned modern cdb text (modern_text_matches_version index 1, exact), so no text transition is implementation-relevant: v0 (PSV-054, 2002-10-20) -> v1 is cosmetic and predates the baseline version; v2 (Legendary Collection, 2010-10-01) condenses the same effect; v3 (PSV-EN054, Pharaoh's Servant 25th Anniversary Edition, 2023-04-20) restores the v1 wording. The only other diff line is namespacing — the goat script counts copies in the Graveyard by the real passcode 63689843.
